question: 第一批关税何时生效，额外税率是多少？

facts.claim: 第一批额外关税适用于2018-07-06及之后进入消费或从仓库提取消费的相关商品。
相关中国商品的额外从价税率为25%。
最终初始行动清单缩减为818个税则子目。

sources.title: 2018年6月初始公告（含后续拟议行动）
sources.quote: Applicable date of duties: The additional duties set out in Annex A to this notice are applicable with respect to products that are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, on or after July 6, 2018.

sources.title: 2018年6月初始公告（含后续拟议行动）
sources.quote: Products of China that are provided for in new HTSUS heading 9903.88.01, as established by Annex A of this notice that are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, on or after 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July 6, 2018, shall be subject to an additional duty of 25 percent ad valorem.
